answer_1.quote: In this paper we study the type discovery problem: automatically identifying and extracting new relation and event types from a given corpus.
answer_1.outputs: clusters of relation and event types with predicted type names

answer_2.quote: The following metrics for cluster quality evaluation are adopted: Accuracy, BCubed-F1 , V measure , Adjusted Rand Index(ARI)

answer_4.quote: In the human evaluation Table , annotators judged 70% of discovered clusters to be semantically coherent compared to 59% of the clusters from the ETypeClus pipeline.
answer_4.guideline: For each cluster, we present the top 10 and bottom 10 instances and ask annotators if this cluster is meaningful and relevant to the corpus.
